question: Does a native motor decision acquire an extra informative taste when it is valuable, while retaining competence to use the information?
parent: Uniform-query memory learner at 8000 updates from retention-objective or retention-objective-confirmation. All 20 nodes, local trace rule, weights, bias and directed birth support as inherited. Fast numeric and structural writes stay open on every genuine contact.
paired_histories: In each world target X is either studied with a reliable taste, or matched to an alternative history: another odor Y with an independent taste, or exposure to X with no taste. A second unrelated object B is studied in the same random position, with its own private law. Cross both X and B signs within each history. Costs and all sensory orientations, motor uniforms, editing uniforms, actual history order and neutral gaps are shared across the history twins. No history identifier enters the graph.
game: The graph sees X for 5 reaction ticks without committing a choice, then sees a public left/right ticket-versus-pass menu. The ticket mark and sign are freshly placed per world. Posted price is a bilateral common sensory component. The sampled native side either buys information or declines. Both leave the same total time and subsequent target menu. Buying costs the posted amount (delivered through the ordinary taste channel) and grants one additional real taste of X at the side subsequently chosen; skipping produces a taste-free passage through that menu. Support activities and structural/numeric updates remain continuous. A separately randomized ordinary final action for X pays 1 for the valuable side, 0 otherwise. Utility is actual final payment less realized ticket cost, not correctness of a counterfactual side.
comparison: Four training runs: native contingent/coin-allocated, each in both birth cohorts, 8000 updates with a fresh Adam at .003. In the coin group the environment selects which lanes buy with probability .5, independent of motor output; the native route action and body trajectory are still sampled. Each arm has exactly the same menus, physical contact opportunities, outcome units and optimizer budget; informative exposures and price paid may differ due to endogenous choice. Prices .05, .25 and .55; four independent geometries per birth per update, crossed into eight matched lanes; two support contacts per life. Save 0, 2000, 4000 and 8000.
frozen_tests: Use both unseen geometries and continuous prices held out where stated. Give the same actor an actual choice, force purchase, force skip, or remove the information despite purchase. Use exact counterfactual decision utilities to randomize its purchases within matched seen/unseen history pairs while holding purchase count and posted price fixed. Report bought fraction by previous evidence and price, net payoff vs this allocation and vs the best constant/price-only action determined on different calibration worlds. Remove all private information from decision before any contact as a sanity condition.
limitations: The scene supplies the market convention, a single opportunity, explicit tariff and deterministic binary taste. The primary observable evidence distinction between a prior true taste and no prior evidence is a learnable familiarity/reliability cue; success alone would not demonstrate unrestricted introspection or autonomous recall scheduling.
